name: Staff of Farryn of the Greenwood

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from Hartsblight Forest; the book's numbers, our words.

powers.name: Servant of the Cycle
powers.text: Cure Wounds at 3rd level; your next hit deals 1d10 Necrotic more.

powers.name: Cycle's Balance
powers.text: Revivify. For an hour, the next creature to fail a save against your spell bursts with rot: 4d10 Necrotic to your foes within 20 ft of it.

powers.name: Sacrifice of Flesh
powers.text: While on, your healing spells cost you twice their level in Necrotic damage and heal their target three times what you took.

summary: A Fabled Heirloom staff of the Greenwood's druid: +1 to spell attacks and save DCs (+2 at level 7, +3 at 13), Resistance to Necrotic damage, and Servant of the Cycle (Cure Wounds at 3rd level three times a dusk, and the next hit rots). From level 7, Revivify once a dusk with a burst of rot to follow, and Sacrifice of Flesh (pay in your own flesh to heal three times as much).
